results.name: AdjoinRoot.lift
results.source_text:
/-- Lift a ring homomorphism `i : R →+* S` to `AdjoinRoot f →+* S`. -/
def lift (i : R →+* S) (x : S) (h : f.eval₂ i x = 0) : AdjoinRoot f →+* S := by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.lift _ (eval₂RingHom i x)
  intro g H
  rcases mem_span_singleton.1 H with ⟨y, hy⟩
  rw [hy, map_mul, coe_eval₂RingHom, h, zero_mul]
results.docstring: Lift a ring homomorphism `i : R →+* S` to `AdjoinRoot f →+* S`.

results.name: AdjoinRoot.lift_mk
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem lift_mk (g : R[X]) : lift i a h (mk f g) = g.eval₂ i a :=
  Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk _ _ _

results.name: AdjoinRoot
results.source_text:
/-- Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`. -/
def AdjoinRoot [CommRing R] (f : R[X]) : Type _ :=
  Polynomial R ⧸ (span {f} : Ideal R[X])
results.docstring:
Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`.

results.name: ULift.instRootableBy
results.source_text:
@[to_additive]
instance ULift.instRootableBy [RootableBy A α] : RootableBy (ULift A) α where
  root x a := ULift.up <| RootableBy.root x.down a
  root_zero x := ULift.ext _ _ <| RootableBy.root_zero x.down
  root_cancel _ h := ULift.ext _ _ <| RootableBy.root_cancel _ h
